title: Juicy Tender Moroccan Runner Beans Khlea
description: A rich and tender Moroccan dish featuring runner beans, sashimi-cut and cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer, halal-friendly and full of energizing flavors.
instructions: Fill a large pot with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and place a bamboo steamer over the pot.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sashimi-cut runner beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Place the runner beans in the bamboo steamer, leaving some space between each bean for even cooking.
Cover the steamer with a lid and steam the runner beans for 10 minutes, or until tender.
Remove the runner beans from the steamer and place them on a serving platter.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the runner beans and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the Moroccan runner beans khlea hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
